objective.total_loss: PPO + 1.0*方向辅助(4 行 H32, mean(relu(.05−y·m)²)) + 1.0*gate(2 行 flat rem=1, −mean(log p_flat))
objective.p_flat: pH+(1−pH)·p0;log_p_flat=logaddexp(logpH, logpREBAL+logA0);A0=冻结分布 merged 零原子(mix_zero+mix_cont·b0,不重算)
objective.declared_change: 目标与监督剂量同时改变(方向 4 行保留+gate 2 行=6 行同批,零额外 optimizer step);不冒称原净 log 单目标;λ_gate=1 仅单一候选
prohibited: 修改 MDP/奖励/P0/HOLD/REBAL 语义
H1 标签施加给 H32/已有仓位/其它期限
把 aux 条件均值 m 当概率

inputs.gate_rows: rem=1,s=±1,q=1,c=1,g=0,flat/solvency40;其余观测与原 H32 编码相同

boundary.preteach: 256 方向预教学整段保留(不含 gate)
boundary.rule: 确定性重建后严格比较参数/Adam/RNG/obs/flags;匹配→post_aux_matched;否则明确 post_aux_new,不伪称同起点;比较只读零污染

panels: 六批:pre_aux/post_aux+8192/16384/24576/32768(末次即 final,post-update tap;阈值核 epoch/opt/dir/gate=80/320/320/320…320/1280/1280/1280);每批恰 1 forward

eval.strict: valid is True;net_log 缺失/None/非有限拒;eval 后 params_digest 不变

writer.data_first: eval_data/eval_actions 先独立原子落,summary 引用
writer.taxonomy: completed/failed/serialization_refused;首因保留;不覆盖已落 failed receipt;RUNNING/遗留 DONE→FAILED
